Compare CMSY++ Runs, or CMSY++ with Other Assessments

Source: R/cmsy_tools.R
cmsy_compare.Rd

This function draws B/Bmsy and F/Fmsy of the same stocks from several runs of cmsy_run() (e.g. with different start years or priors, a sensitivity analysis) and, optionally, from other assessments, and gives a table of their last-year values.

Usage

cmsy_compare(
  ...,
  stocks = NULL,
  external = NULL,
  lang = NULL,
  annotations = getOption("faofishingreport.cmsy_annotations", FALSE),
  pptx = getOption("faofishingreport.pptx", FALSE),
  silent = fao_setting("silent")
)

Arguments

...

Results of cmsy_run(), named or not (e.g. default = run1, start_1980 = run2).

stocks

Optional stocks to compare: Stock identifiers or species, by English or Chinese FAO name, scientific name or FAO 3-alpha code. Default is NULL, all stocks that ran.

external

Optional data frame of other estimates, with columns Stock, Year, B_Bmsy (and optionally F_Fmsy) and source (the name shown in the legend, e.g. the agency or model of the other assessment).

lang

The language of the chart text and names: "en" (English), "zh" (Chinese) or "both" (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses the language set with fao_settings() ("en" unless changed).

annotations

The text added to the axis titles and labels: FALSE (default) none, TRUE all, or any of "title", "subtitle", "caption", "legend" and "labels" (text inside the chart). The default can be changed for the session with options(faofishingreport.cmsy_annotations = TRUE).

pptx

A logical value. If TRUE, the charts are also saved as editable PowerPoint files in figures/pptx/cmsy/compare/. Default is FALSE, which can be changed for all functions with fao_settings(pptx = TRUE).

silent

A logical value. If TRUE, the messages on how the stocks were matched are not printed. Default is FALSE, or the value set with fao_settings(silent = ).

Value

Invisibly, a list with last_year (one row per stock and run) and plots.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Sensitivity to the start year
run_1950 <- cmsy_run(input, stocks = "GRB_34", seed = 1)
run_auto <- cmsy_run(input, stocks = "GRB_34", seed = 1, auto_start = TRUE)
cmsy_compare(`from 1950` = run_1950, `CMSY++ start year` = run_auto, annotations = "legend")

# Sensitivity to a CMSY++ setting (see cmsy_defaults())
run_sigma <- cmsy_run(input, stocks = "GRB_34", seed = 1, auto_start = TRUE, settings = list(sigmaR = 0.2))
cmsy_compare(default = run_auto, `sigmaR = 0.2` = run_sigma)$last_year

# With another assessment of the same stock, read from a file with the columns
# Stock, Year, B_Bmsy (optionally F_Fmsy) and source
other <- read.csv("other_assessment.csv")
cmsy_compare(CMSY = run_auto, external = other, annotations = "legend")
} # }
